$comment: Single source of truth for this book. Same convention as the existing Valice book repositories:
constants live here, never hard-coded in build scripts. Every field that is not yet decided is null,
and null renders as absent — never as a guess. Counts under `measured` are written by build/QA
scripts from the manuscript, never by hand.

founder.author: Emre Doğan
founder.authorBio$comment: null blocks Gate 9: KDP rejected a placeholder bio as template text (World Myths, 2026-08-12).

measured.$comment: Written by scripts only (draft-lint, preflight). A subtitle may only quote a number that appears here.

production.$comment: ink: black | standard-color | premium-color. premium-color nets ~$0.99/unit on a $24.99 book — Gate 10 warns.

formats$comment: status: not_planned | planned | built | preflight_ok | uploaded | in_review | live | withdrawn. A format may be `uploaded` only when the project state is APPROVED or later (state.json).

rights.differentiation$comment: For public-domain editions: translated | annotated | illustrated (KDP rule). null otherwise.
rights.sources$comment: One entry per source: { id, title, kind: text|image|data|font, license, ledgerRow }. Every id must have a row in valice-house/rights/ledger.csv.

metadata.title: {{title}}
metadata.seriesLinked$comment: KDP series metadata opens only when volume 2 is real (Hangul decision).

aiDisclosure.$comment: Each value: generated | assisted | none. `generated` must be declared at every KDP upload. Only the founder decides.

compliance.backMatterLinks$comment: Each link: { url, purpose }. purpose may not be a form that collects customer information (KDP hyperlink rule).

companion.printedUrl$comment: The address printed inside the book. Permanent. Only `valicepress.com/companion/<slug>`.
